description: Submit a disputed passage for review because it may be wrong, outdated, or missing a source. No API key is required. Reports enter the reviewer queue and do not change published content.

dataset.description: Dataset id or slug the passage came from

document_id.description: Optional document id from the passage citation

note.description: What is wrong and, if known, the correct value or a URL that shows it

passage.description: The disputed passage text; optional when query is present

query.description: The question that surfaced the passage, when the passage text is unavailable

name: koskamo_report_fact
title: Report a disputed passage
